description: This file defines the interface for managing temporary object directories within a version control system, likely Git. It declares structures and functions to create, configure, migrate, destroy, and reconfigure temporary object directories, facilitating operations like stash management, object migration, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_create
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory with a specified prefix for a given repository, returning a pointer to the structure or NULL on failure.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_env
methods.description: Returns environment variables as an array of strings that configures subprocesses to use the temporary object directory.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_migrate
methods.description: Finalizes the temporary object directory by migrating its objects into the main database and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the temporary object directory and discards its objects.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_discard_objects
methods.description: Removes all objects from the temporary directory without deleting the directory itself.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate
methods.description: Adds the temporary directory as an alternate object store in the current process.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb
methods.description: Replaces the main object database in the current process with the temporary directory, optionally destroying it.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Restores the original primary object database if it was replaced.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Reapplies the original primary object database with a potential change in working directory.
